prompt: How can a docker-compose service be restarted when the healthcheck fails? Please, explain step by step.  Then, suggest code.
response: To restart a service when its healthcheck fails, you can use the `restart` policy in `docker-compose.yml`. Set `restart: on-failure` under the service to ensure it restarts only on failure. The healthcheck configuration is not directly linked to restarts, so focus on setting up a robust healthcheck command. This setup ensures the service is resilient to failures.
